outcome: An ability referring to cards exiled with this object affects only cards exiled by its linked ability, not cards exiled by other sources.
An ability referring to cards exiled with this object affects only cards exiled by the linked replacement effect.
An ability referring to objects put onto the battlefield with this object affects only objects its linked ability put there.
An ability referring to the chosen value uses only the value chosen by its linked ability, and does nothing without one.
An ability referring to noted information uses only what its linked ability noted.
An ability referring to a choice between rules-less words uses only the word chosen by its linked ability.
An ability referring to the cost paid as this object entered sees only the cost paid by its linked ability.
A triggered ability in the same paragraph as a static ability refers only to actions taken as a result of that static ability.
An ability that checks whether an additional cost was paid sees only whether its linked cost was paid, so the matching trigger fires and others do not.
An ability referring to the variable cost paid as this was cast sees only the value chosen for its linked cost.
The champion keyword's two abilities are linked, so the return ability returns only the card exiled by the champion ability.
An ability preceded by an anchor word applies only according to the choice made by the linked anchor-word ability.

choice made before the game begins; game start procedure

outcome: A permanent's ability referring to cards exiled with it sees only cards exiled to pay the cost of the spell that became it.
When a linked single-card reference meets several exiled cards, the ability acts on, sums over or creates a copy for each exiled card.
An ability linked to several others refers to each linked ability's actions independently.
Abilities acquired together stay linked to each other only, so exiled cards from a different acquired ability cannot be used.
An ability referring to an undefined choice does nothing.
